retained_findings: Current F2 request_sha256 is an exact per-call authority-request digest, not a proven cross-attempt semantic digest, because canonical_entityos_call_target embeds binding_id, invocation_id, tool_use_id, delegation_id and child identity.

Current invocation_id is source-contracted as part of one delegated execution lineage. It may become an attempt identity only through an explicit future contract; it is not proven to be a stable logical retry identity.
Current EntityOS EffectGate cross-attempt replay protection is autonomy-episode specific; episode_id=null direct callers bypass that fence, while EffectJournal.begin creates a fresh UUID effect_id.

Current EffectJournal lacks distinct DISPATCH_STARTED and UNKNOWN_POST_DISPATCH states; live bridge exceptions are finalized FAILED even when F2 has component evidence that executor entry preceded TimeoutExpired.

AWS Powertools commit a39e1018e36b7965b08313288bea3b7420df5220 is retained only as a structural donor: separate stable idempotency key from payload validation hash, INPROGRESS exclusion, fail closed when active-vs-orphan is uncertain, and mismatch rejection. No Redis/DynamoDB side authority is adopted.

The minimal generated ABI therefore separates operation_retry_id, retry-stable operation_payload_sha256, per-attempt identity, existing request_sha256, canonical effect_id, dispatch state, outcome certainty and verification evidence.
counterevidence_preserved: request_sha256 alone cannot safely be promoted to logical retry identity in current F2
goal_id + autonomy_step_id does not cover direct episode_id=null calls
FAILED after post-start exception is not evidence that the world effect did not occur
a full external idempotency runtime would introduce an unnecessary competing persistence/effect substrate

next_discriminator.summary: Use an admitted zero-cost no-real-effect miniature with UnifiedDB persistence, reopen between attempts, and prove zero second child mutation under one unresolved operation_retry_id plus mismatch rejection for changed operation_payload_sha256.
